notes.title: Ramayana Source is now Open for All
notes.content:
Ramayana source code is now available on GitHub.

This was my college hobby project experimenting with C++, OpenGL, OpenSDL, OpenCV, Pathfinding algorithms, DirectX shaders, Blender etc. Had fun making it public back then with mixed reviews. Making it open source now. ːsteammockingː

Follow the below URL to access it.

[url=https://github.com/rakeshmalik91/ramayana-rts]Github Repository[/url]
